summary: This Form 6-K filed by Aspen Insurance Holdings Limited reports the immediate resignation of CFO Mark Pickering effective June 29, 2026, with no stated disagreement. The board simultaneously appointed Carrie Rosorea as successor CFO. No financial terms, premium, or consideration are involved. As a foreign private issuer filing under Rule 13a-16, this is equivalent to a U.S. Form 8-K Item 5.02 departure of principal officer. Watch for transition stability and any subsequent strategic shifts under new CFO.
